lead_raw_text:
The structure of CeMnSi₂ is hexagonal, space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Ce₂Mn₂Si₄—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Mn centers in octahedral environments with six Si neighbors, while Si centers show five geometric neighbors (one Ce, three Mn, one Si) and Ce centers show twelve (six Ce, six Si). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and corner, edge, and face sharing between Ce and Mn polyhedra.
